title: IT Help Desk Work Order Form
subtitle: IT Help-Desk Service: connects authorized scope to results.
description: IT Help Desk Work Order Form covers user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function. The service desk coordinator records IT Help-Desk Service authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. IT Help Desk Work Order Form keeps IT Help-Desk Service exceptions visible until the service desk coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use IT Help Desk Work Order Form at approved remote session, user workspace, equipment room, or service environment. Document user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function identity before IT Help-Desk Service begins. Compare user account, endpoint, application, network path, service, and business function findings with stated IT Help-Desk Service criteria; route unresolved IT Help-Desk Service issues to authorized IT support reviewer. For IT Help Desk Work Order Form, confirm requirements for IT Help-Desk Service. Ask authorized IT support reviewer to review IT Help-Desk Service conditions beyond the service desk coordinator's role.
